## Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist
- [ ] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [ ] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [ ] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.


## Purpose

Currently, processing large dummy inputs takes 40 secs of the startup time for Qwen2/2.5-VL (it happens twice and each takes 20 secs). This can be skipped by pre-computing the maximum token count per modality.

review_planner.summary: The changes introduce a new method `get_max_tokens_per_item` in three files. This method is intended to return the maximum number of tokens per item for each modality, which can improve performance by avoiding dummy input generation and processing.
